r: **Named the Ceded Districts (Dattamandalam) "Rayalaseema"** at the **1928 Nandyal Andhra Mahasabha** – after the Vijayanagara Rayas
**Swarajya (1907, Vijayawada; earlier Sri Venkateswara Patrika)**, Navayugam, Andhra Patrika (editor 1916-18), Matru Seva, Panchayati Rajyam
Section 124A, 3 years, for his Swarajya writings – the **first Telugu journalist / political prisoner jailed for sedition (treason) in South India**
The student expelled from the **Rajahmundry Teacher Training College (1907)** and blacklisted from government jobs
Started the Home Rule League branches in Andhra; its secretary; **linked the library movement to the Home Rule League**
Ayyanki (**built institutions**), **Gadicherla (mobilised people – the "radical mobiliser")**, Kasinathuni (**money and political backing**)

0.x: **Edward Corporation Library, Nandyal** (now Victoria Reading Room) – with **Kaderbad Narasinga Rao**.
**President** of the library association in **1946**; **Komma Sitaramayya's** gift bought a building → **Sarvottama Bhavan**, opened **1949** in his honour.

r: **Started (led) the library movement** – "**Father of the Library Movement**"; said "**Library Movement in Andhra is Swayambhu**"; slogan "Public libraries are temples of knowledge"
**Secretary, Rama Mohana Library**, Vijayawada (1911); founder-secretary of the **ADLA (1914)**; edited ***Grandhalaya Sarvasvam*** (1915)
**Conceived the library pilgrimage** (village tours, 1934-48); began **library-science training classes in 1920**; trained library workers at the **Vijayawada training classes of 1934**
Organised the All India Public Library Conference (Madras, Nov 1919); General Secretary of the All India Public Library Association at its second conference (**Dec 1923**)
Granthalaya Pitamaha (from the **Maharaja of Baroda**); Saraswati Samrajya Pratishtapanacharya; Granthala Visaradha; **first Indian with the Kaula Gold Medal**; **Padma Shri**
**Andhra Desa Granthalayodyama Roopasilpi**; "University of Humanity", "Walking Library" (from **Karunasri – Jandhyala Papayya Sastri**); **Kala Prapoorna** (Andhra University, 1975)
**Velaga Venkatappayya** – led tours in Bhimavaram, Tadepalligudem, Kovvur and Guntur taluks
**Pioneer of the boat library service** – on passenger boats on the **Bank Canal**, **1935-42** (seven years)
Started the **Bala Saraswati Bhandaramu** village library as a schoolboy; as Secretary of the **Guntur Library Association** set up libraries in about **160 villages**
Member of the drafting committee of the **AP Public Libraries Act (1960)**
Books to the Ramamohan Library and free copies to village libraries
